name: Opus Clip
shortDescription: Cuts long videos into short clips. The free plan lists 60 credits per month.
longDescription: Opus Clip turns long videos into short clips. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed a free plan at $0 with 60 credits per month, a watermark, and clips that stop being exportable after 3 days. Starter was $15 per month. We did not upload a video.
pricingNotes: Confirm free trial vs free plan on opus.pro/pricing.
freeTierNotes: 60 credits per month. Watermark. Clips stop being exportable after 3 days.
bestFor: Cutting a stream VOD or long video into shorts
Creators who want a hosted clipper
notIdealFor: A confirmed forever-free plan from this check
strength: The free plan includes 60 credits per month for cutting a long video into short clips.
weakness: Free clips carry a watermark and stop being exportable after 3 days.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
